raw.rationale: MEK inhibitors like this compound typically show selective sensitivity in BRAF/RAS/NF1-mutant lineages, especially melanoma (skin) and some lung, colorectal, and thyroid cancers, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days broad cytotoxicity reduces lineage selectivity; PRISM data for MEK inhibitors show strongest selective effects in skin (melanoma) and modest signals in lung, colorectal, and ovary, with most other lineages near baseline.
